description: Add exponential-backoff retry to NetworkSwitchService.processPayment on transient network switch timeouts.
tech_spec: Modify NetworkSwitchService.processPayment() to automatically retry up to 3 times with exponential backoff (100ms, 200ms, 400ms) on SocketTimeoutException and ConnectException. Use Spring Retry's @Retryable annotation rather than hand-rolled retry loops. Log each retry attempt at WARN level. Do not retry on business-logic exceptions.
brd: Partners intermittently experience transient network failures when the network switch is under load. Currently these surface as user-visible payment failures. Requirement: retry transient failures silently; surface only after all retries exhausted.
notes: Reviewer should reject solutions that add a new RetryUtility class — @Retryable is idiomatic.

description: Add a new GET /api/v1/balance endpoint returning current balance for a VPA.
tech_spec: Add a new REST endpoint GET /api/v1/balance that accepts a VPA query parameter (e.g. user@network), looks up the current balance via an existing BalanceService, and returns JSON {"vpa": "user@network", "balance_paise": 1000}. Use @RestController, @GetMapping, @RequestParam with @NotBlank validation. Return 404 if VPA not found, 400 if VPA format invalid.
brd: Partner apps need a real-time balance enquiry endpoint that doesn't require initiating a transaction. Must return balance in paise (integer) to avoid floating-point errors.
notes: New controller, not modifying existing one. Should reuse existing BalanceService, not create a new one.

description: Add a `failureReason` field to the PayRequest entity and propagate it.
tech_spec: Add a new `String failureReason` column to the PayRequest entity (nullable, max 500 chars). Update the JPA mapping, add getter/setter, and ensure the field is populated in the error-handling path of NetworkSwitchService.processPayment(). When a payment fails, set failureReason to the exception message (truncated to 500 chars).
brd: Ops team currently has no visibility into why specific payments failed. They need failureReason persisted on the PayRequest row for retrospective triage.
notes: Requires a database migration in practice — not tested here but mentioned in notes to reviewer.

description: Add a NetworkTimeoutException and throw it from NetworkSwitchService on switch timeouts.
tech_spec: Create a new checked exception class NetworkTimeoutException extending RuntimeException with (String message, Throwable cause) constructors. Modify NetworkSwitchService.processPayment() to catch SocketTimeoutException and rethrow as NetworkTimeoutException. Add a @ExceptionHandler in the global controller advice to map NetworkTimeoutException to HTTP 504.
brd: Currently all exceptions surface as HTTP 500. Ops wants timeout errors distinguishable via HTTP 504 so dashboards can track them separately.
notes: Three-file change: new exception, modified service, modified handler.

description: Add a @ValidVpa custom annotation + validator and apply it on input DTOs.
tech_spec: Add a new custom Jakarta Bean Validation annotation @ValidVpa that validates a String matches the network VPA format (local-part@handle, per the Authority VPA rules — alphanumeric + underscore + dot in local-part, alphanumeric in handle). Create VpaValidator implementing ConstraintValidator<ValidVpa, String>. Apply @ValidVpa on the `vpa` field of PaymentInitiateRequest DTO.
brd: Currently VPA format validation is scattered across controllers. Centralize it behind a single @ValidVpa annotation so all request DTOs get consistent validation.
notes: Bean Validation idiom — annotation + validator pair.

description: Add a tenacity-style retry decorator to a Python service method (Slice 25c — Python case).
tech_spec: Add a `@retry_with_backoff(max_attempts=3, base_delay=0.1)` decorator to the `process_payment` method of `NetworkSwitchService` in `app/services/upi_switch.py`. Decorator must catch only TimeoutError + ConnectionError; log each attempt at WARNING; raise the last exception if all attempts exhausted. Use the existing `app.core.retry` module if it has a backoff helper, otherwise add one alongside.
brd: Python services intermittently fail on transient network errors. Need silent retries with backoff before surfacing the failure to upstream consumers.
notes: Python equivalent of Slice 25's cc001. Validates that polyglot retrieval surfaces Python service modules in code_change context.

description: Add a new TypeScript Express route handler (Slice 25c — TS case).
tech_spec: Add a new GET `/api/v1/balance` route handler in `src/routes/balance.ts`. Accepts a `vpa` query parameter (string, required); looks up balance via `BalanceService.getBalance(vpa)`; returns `{ vpa, balancePaise: number }`. Uses Express `Request`/`Response` types. Add a `@types/express`-compatible signature.
brd: Partner JS apps need a balance enquiry endpoint that doesn't initiate a transaction. Must be type-safe TypeScript.
notes: TypeScript equivalent of Slice 25's cc002 controller case. Validates TS retrieval + type-aware code generation.

description: Add a plain-JS VPA validator function (Slice 25c — JS case).
tech_spec: Add a new `validateVpa(vpa)` function exported from `src/util/vpa-validator.js`. Validates the network VPA format: `local-part@handle` where local-part is alphanumeric+underscore+dot and handle is alphanumeric. Returns `{ valid: boolean, reason?: string }`. Pure function, no I/O.
brd: Frontend forms need client-side VPA validation matching the server's @ValidVpa annotation rules.
notes: Plain JavaScript (not TS). Validates JS retrieval + ESM/CJS-aware emit.
